## Voluntary public character idea / 自愿公开投稿

- [ ] I want to share this idea publicly. / 我自愿公开分享，不投稿也能完整使用游戏。
- [ ] No API keys, private conversations, personal data or third-party private material. / 不含密钥、私聊或敏感资料。
- [ ] I understand maintainers and GitHub users can read this PR; accepted ideas may improve later character versions. / 理解维护者和公众可阅读，创意可能用于后续版本。
- [ ] I reviewed the diff and removed anything I do not want public. / 已检查差异内容。

### Idea / 创意
Describe only the parts you want public; do not attach character.custom.md or private logs.

### Permission / 授权范围
State your ownership and the permission you grant. Maintainers will ask before accepting unclear rights.

### Deletion / 删除请求
Request deletion by contacting maintainers through the repository. Public forks, clones and Git history may remain; do not post sensitive text in the request itself.
